nom: Peter Thomas Roth Water Drench Hyaluronic Cloud Hydra-Gel Eye Patches

avis.texte: I bought these patches a few months ago now from another retailer. They've damaged my skin barrier under my left eye beyond repair, my eye has been swollen and red for months now, and no creams nor any treatment is making it go away. I get married in 8 weeks, and this is exactly what I don't need! I haven't changed my skin routine in years but thought I'd give these a go to help brighten my under eye, what a mistake that was. Do not buy these patches unless you want a damaged skin barrier and swollen eyes. They're awful and the price they're charging for these is ridiculous.

These gave changed!!!!!! Ive used these mearly every day for 2-3 yrs and the last batch i got were torally different. The patch itself is thicker and textured. They are almost completely dry. I keep flipping the container and taking them off the bottom just to get a bit of moisture on them. Why oh why did yog change them?! This was the only thing that helped my puffiness, bags and soothed the eye area in the mornings. Probably one of my favorite beauty items in my 42 yrs of life. I woukd have putchased forever but now have to search elsewhere. I just purchased anothef hoping I'll luckily get an old container while i search for a different brand. So sad

I've used these for years and loved them! However, I just received a new order and, as others have noted, they have unfortunately changed. The pads are thicker, dry and they are not moisturizing at all. So disappointed and will have to find a new product.

WHY?!?!?! I've used these every single day for years. I was dreading the day they would change & lo and behold they did. Why would you change perfection? The patches are so different. Thicker and don't seem to absorb the product. I keep having to try to get a pair from the middle of the stack and flipping the jar. The top ones are dry. Change them back!!!!!!!!
I ABSOLUTELY love these eye patches! I paired it with PR water drench cloud moisturizer at night! Sleep with them and wake up looking so rejuvenated and refreshed!
So dissapoointed. These were my favorite eye patches! Whatever change they made recently is not it. 😒
These eye patches were amazing before they changed them. They are now almost stiff, offer little hydration, and start stinging after a few minutes. Please bring back the old formula!

I tried the patches 6 different times, i really wantes it to work. Each time, the burning was unbearable. I kept it on for 10 min once, and my face was red for hours. I know they had burning lawsuit but omg i didnt think it would happen to me. DONT BUY.
The old formula provided a lot of moisture, but now they are almost completely dry. I've used these eye patches for nearly 2 years, but will no longer be purchasing.
I am pretty sure that this product has been reformulated and now offers literally no moisture
They changed the formula . These now burn and have a completely inflexible texture to them
Immediately after puttin them on they burned my skin. Of course it's a personal reaction but be careful!

These are so refreshing and really quick to depuff my under eyes. When I first tried them I assumed I'd like them- But less than the 24k I had been loving for years. Surprisingly, with the lower price point, these might be my favorites! They are so cooling they feel like they've income Out of the fridge and feel so good. Must try.

I have never been so disappointed in a product. I discovered Peter Thomas Roth a couple of years ago and love their moisturizers, and thought I struck gold when I saw their eye patches. Then they arrived. Sooo dry. Come on, PTR, where is that serum? The top pads were dry and very little serum and I thought when I got closer to the bottom there would be some serum but they just kept getting drier and drier. I can't believe what a waste of time and money these were, some serum, as advertised, would have been nice.

I really love these hydragel patches! They feel very cold to the skin, which feels really nice. I definitely noticed that my lines were very hydrated. I love how it feels on the skin and the patches don't slide anywhere! The packaging is nice and the included spoon makes it very easy to separate the patches! You definitely get your bang for your buck with these patches as they will last you a really long time!!!

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I really love these patches. I used both shapes on my crows feet and between my eyes. The eye patches are a little big for me and go over my hairline and brows but I was really surprised by the plumping effect it gave my skin! It doesn't completely get rid of all my fine lines but I didn't expect it to. It definitely did a great job at softening them. I would love this in a full face mask.

Thanks for this product in exchange for my honest review ! These things are amazing at softening under eye bags ! I work third shift, so mine are usually vicious, and these patches are chefs' kiss ! I would definitely recommend this for sure ! Go and get yours !
I used them few times. They are great and hydrating while they are on but i did not see any different results like no reduce puffiness, no reduce dark circles or fine lines.

A great product for dark circles, help me with all my problems, puffiness, wrinkles and brightness. Doesn't have smell or fragrance, very comfy pads. The texture it's the same that every gel eyepatch but have a spoon that help to don't manipulate the product with your hands.

I have combination skin and these patches have been a perfect fit. I use them 2-3 times a week and the results are simply amazing! The frown lines between my eyebrows have significantly smoothed out, and my skin feels more hydrated and radiant. I especially love the cooling sensation, which helps to relieve fatigue.

What a nice product. These patches deliver a targeted dose of peptide. They help to soften and lift expression lines These are perfect to help with fine lines and puffiness for a more youthful appearance. It comes with two different shaped patches. One for between eyebrow and one for helping fine lines and crows feet to apply around the eyes. They're comfortable to wear and only need ten to fifteen minutes to work. It's great for normal skin, combination skin and oily. Give them a try for yourself.

These hydra gel patches are interesting and fun to use. It's adhesive without being sticky, it attaches to the skin perfectly without feeling any suction or leaving any residues. I can put these on and go around doing my stuff. The gel patches have a cooling effect and feel soft on my skin. After 10 minutes of use the gel patches dry up but my skin feels smooth, hydrated and youthful. These patches make my skin look dewy and pampered. I will continue to use them around my eyes and smile lines.
These feel wonderful on your face! They are so soothing and cooling! I can tell they really work too! My face feels so hydrated after a short time!

avis.titre: A must in your skincare routine
avis.texte: Wow! I again found a product through influencer that I will be forever using. I 1000% see a difference in the areas where I applied the patches. It reduced fine lines and wrinkles & hydrated the area. Truly brown away with the quality and efficiency of this product!

It was my first time trying this product. I really like the idea of a hydra gel patch. All ingredients are interesting. The package is nice and came with a small spoon to help collect the patch and gel. The scent is very mild. The patch has a moist texture that helps relax very well. I like to use this product more often because it works effectively for fine wrinkles

avis.titre: Best product for your fine lines!
avis.texte: This is such a great product for your under yes and forehead!' Great to reduce fine lines or any discoloration! I have very sensitive skin and thus is pure gold for me!! My under eyes has never felt or looked better!

Unfortunately, these did not show any immediate results as advertised. The eye patches were a bit big and didn't smooth on well. The 11s patch was perfect. They moistured where they were but had no instant smoothing effect for me. My crows feet and 11 lines look the same. I used for about a week.

I don't know why this is showing up as a different product, but I am reviewing the face patches. They have 2 different shaped patches, which are meant for various spots of your face. One is for the outer corners of your eyes, to minimize crows feet. I don't really have any, but it's nice to use them to prevent any from forming. The other one is to minimize "11" lines which you get between your eyebrows…something I also don't really have, but good to prevent. These patches are pretty moist in the container, but I found them to dry pretty easily when on your face. But I also sit in front of my fan a lot, so that may have contributed. Overall I like these patches, but wish they were shaped differently so I could use them as under eye patches too since that is my biggest problem area.
This Peptide Skinjection Hydra -Gel Patches are great for. It's really effective. It's gives hydration on skin.
Absolutely love these!!! Aging is no fun! But these are amazing!!!

I wanted to love these. Had high hopes. Disappointed. They don't hold much moisture. I don't notice a difference in the area they are placed. I much prefer caudalie cru moisturizer on my eye area or a moisturizing sheet mash.
I wanted to like this product but it was too dry. It didn't do anything. I bought 2 of them to share with my sister . Big disappointment!

avis.titre: Not the same as they once were
avis.texte: I loved these patches when ibstarted ysing them four years ago. I bought them consistently for four years. The last two times I have bought the face moisturizer eye patch combo box. I'm not sure if it's the combo pack itself but the patches are nearly bone dry. No extra liquid in the jar to keep the patches moist enough to do anything. I won't be buying the combo pack again, and I'm not very hopeful the stand alone jar will far mucb better.

I use these 3-4 times weekly. Wash my face in the morning and put these on for about 30 minutes as I get ready for the day. Super hydrating and they stay actually stay put. I have sensitive eyes and these do not irritate at all. The water drench line is my favorite and I use many products from this line. These are my first choice in eye patches and I have tried tons. Perfect for us vintage ladies!

avis.titre: I've completely transformed my skin thanks to PTR
avis.texte: The eye patches were my latest purchase, but I also use the eye cream, cucumber, rose stem and gold masks. All my moisturizers are Water Drench and I use PTR cleanser too!!

Tried the Retinol hydro-gel patches for the first time and they broke off rather easily while applying. Thought it was just me and delicately applied a 2nd time and again broke apart. Very disappointed

avis.titre: I would buy this product again.
avis.texte: It helps me with hydrating my eyes reducing the appearance of puffiness around the eye area. And awakens the undereyes.
I use these OFTEN. I leave them in the fridge and use them night or day. Holy grail product. you can really see a difference!!

Honestly a waste of money. It just feels like silicone pads on my face NO serum. The last few days I used them the patches actually had serum in them, because they were at the bottom. I switched over to patchology eye gels, when you open them you can SEE the serum. Very disappointed in PTR, stop being so cheap and but more serum in the eye patches. I honestly don't think I'd try them again for the price point. I do love lots of PTR products but not any of the patches. It's not just this one, I've done the 24K Gold & Cucumber ones too and the cucumber was a bit better but still lacking in serum.

I love love love this product is so easy to use my place one on under each eye, and I let it sit for 10 minutes, and when I peel them off, my skin is so moisturize, and it does diminish the fine lines!

Compared to other eye patches, these are not worth it. They rip extremely easily and don't sit comfoetably under the eyes. As someone who has tried dozens of different kinds of patches, I would not reccomend these.

I love some of PTR products and some are just a no for me. These eye patches were a little "dry" than what I'm used to getting from other brands. It did stay on my face but it was rather difficult to adjust them without tearing because they were dryer than I'm normally used to. It did somewhat hydrate my eyes. I got this with the moisturizer combo that came with the eye patches so I literally got these for free so I'll be keeping them but I probably won't buy it again,

avis.titre: Such a cooking and moisturizing eye mask!
avis.texte: I am obsessed with these! They are so cooling and reduce puffiness so well. I keep mine in the freezer and adds to it! They are moisturizing and so easy to apply and take on the go. I was gifted by peter Thomas Roth clinical skincare but reviews are my own opinion

When I want a product I always like to look at the ingredients first and I love knowing that it has ceramides, collagen and marshmallow root extract as the main ones. I feel that the lower eye area is more rested and I use it at night, since I always have a very long day at work and many hours in front of the computer, it really leaves my eye area hydrated, others do not have. annoying dark circles this was a free product to try and i am delighted with the results

I am all about eye patches and how beneficial they are. I loved the material of the patches, and they did hydrate my undereyes. I keep them on longer than 15 minutes. It woke up my tired eyes, softened my under area, and I saw less puffiness. I love this brand, and it works for my skin type. Gifted by Peter Thomas Roth in exchange for my honest review.

avis.titre: I love the feel of these eye patches!!
avis.texte: These eye patches were gifted to me and they did not disappoint!! I am an eye patch girl so it takes a lot to empress me and these did!! They are so hydrating under the eye and feel really cool. I like to use them after not getting enough sleep!! They definitely help my eyes feel hydrated and refreshed in the morning!!

I really liked these so far, they had a cooling effect to depuff even without keeping it in the fridge like I normally do. I love all the ingredients in it- I felt like the hyaluronic acid really did help with some of the fine lines that morning. Overall, it is super refreshing and I think it would be a great every day mask or even a gift to a girlfriend! Probably my favorite eye patches to date. I received this complimentary from Peterthomasroth.

avis.titre: Meets all my eye patch wants
avis.texte: I received this product complimentary from Peter Thomas Roth in exchange for my honest opinion. I am absolutely in love with these eye patches. I like a big, saturated in serum eye patch and these meet all my requirements. They give an instant boost of hydration and it's just what I love from an eye patch.

I like using these under eye patches every morning. They plump the area, hydrate and soften my fine lines very well. And these these do not irritate my eyes. Store them in the fridge for the better effect. Great product! Kindly gifted by Peter Thomas Roth Clinical Skincare, however all opinions are my own.
I absolutely love these eye patches's. I have never used eye patches before and my life is officially changed. They are so soothing and hydrating and are perfect to use before makeup. I am obsessed.

These refresh the undereye area, and I enjoy the cooling effect. I like to use this in conjunction with a face mask. I find that they hydrate my under-eye area and also help brighten it. Gifted by Peter Thomas Roth.

What's better than a relaxing eye mask? I felt these had enough serum on them without dripping down my face. My undereyes felt rejuvenated and looked less puffy when I used these! They're pricy but I feel it's worth it! Received complimentary from Peter Thomas Roth

I love these eye patches gifted by Peter Thomas Roth they are the best. Very cooling and seen an imediate results of a brighter fuller look under my eyes after applying. I put them in the fridge, let then sit for 20 mins and removed them rubbing in the assess and it worked wonders 10/10 Would recommend & purchase over and over

I love these eye patches by Peter Thomas Roth they are the best. Very cooling and seen an imediate results of a brighter fuller look under my eyes after applying. I put them in the fridge, let then sit for 20 mins and removed them rubbing in the assess and it worked wonders 10/10

These eye patches are HUGE and I love that! It covers more area under my eyes, giving me more hydration in the morning as I wear these. They are so relaxing and not too juicy where it'll slide down your face. My eye area feels so refreshed and away after wearing these while I get ready in the morning. Love, but don't love the price. Complimentary from Peter Thomas Roth.

Oooh hello hydrated eyes! These have been a lifesaver here in Florida. We spend alot of time in the sun on the water here and my skin is just so dry especially the thin skin around my eyes and these really brighten them up and give them life back. Definitely recommend. *Gifted by Peter Thomas Roth

The water drench hyaluronic cloud eye patches are great for a little extra hydration with the hyaluronic acid and I love using them for a little spa like feeling at home. Complimentary from Peter Thomas Roth

This hydrates and smooths my undereyes and leaves this area smooth and fresh looking. My under eyes felt smooth and plump after using these! It gives my under eyes a huge boost! This was gifted by Peter Thomas Roth

I was gifted by Peter Thomas Roth these water drench eye patches! I absolutely love how cooling and hydrating these are! My bag seem to just disappear! I would definitely purchase again. Give them a try

I love everything I have ever tried from Peter Thomas Roth. I was so excited to get these water drench hyaluronic acid cloud eye patches. I have never used any before. They work wonders! Leave your skin and undersea feeling so hydrated and moisturized. It brightens the area and I can't wait to keep using it! Gifted by Peter Thomas Roth.

This product was gifted by Peter Thomas Roth. I loved using these cloud eye patches! They are super gentle and are the perfect eye patches if you suffer from dark circles and puffiness. I also love that they aid in minimizing fine lines and crows feet. We love anti-aging!

Excellent eye gels! They are super hydrating. I am 40 and need extra hydration to make sure that my fine lines are less noticeable. Immediately after using these my under eyes appeared more youthful and supple. A new favorite! Gifted by Peter Thomas Roth

These are patches are sooo good! I've used them twice and I've noticed an imporvement in the appearance under my eyes. These are very hydrated and help with puffiness and my eyes don't look as tired. Would definitely recommend! I received this product complimentary from Peter Thomas Roth in exchange for my honest review.

Such a great pick me up in the morning! I love how cooling they are which helps to instantly depuff. I'm a new mom that doesn't get a lot of sleep so these really help me look more awake, and it's a nice little low effort self care moment. So happy with the results and how plump my under eyes look, concealer applies like a dream after. Gifted by Peter Thomas Roth.

Peter Thomas Roth has never let me down! I've recently started a new job with long hours, and my tired eyes were in much need of some extra TLC! I have crow's feet, and I feel my skin is now hydrated and plump using these patches.

I have dark circle and eye patches are a must. These Peter Thomas Roth Water Drench Hyaluronic Cloud Hydra-Gel Eye Patches are so moisturizing and extremely hydrating. After I take off the patches and leaves this cool feeling and for my experience it felt like my under eyes were slightly tighter. Also, for morning cool feel, put the package in a mini fridge. Best morning feeling. #giftedbyPeterThomasRoth

I was gifted by peter thomas roth. My screen has been very under my eyes. I think from too much time in the sun. These eye patches have been so nice for that. Also i've noticed after usethe fine lines in my eyes are no longer visble.

Got these for my hubby and I, we noticed in shock and horror that into our mid/late twenties, our skin isn't quite as youthful anymore. The eye patches are super hydrating, VERY slippery, somewhat hard to get out of the container with the included spatula but they're AMAZING. I've tried other PTR eye patches and these are my favorite so far. The hydration is super obvious on these, as they're still super wet even after you're supposed to remove them. Relaxing, soothing, effective and honestly fun to put on. Gifted by PTR :)

These are great eye patches! I absolutely adore the baby blue color and that is why I decided to get them. They stick on nicely and I like that there are so many in the packaging. The eye patches aren't too heavy. Gifted by Peter Thomas Roth.

avis.titre: Water Drench Hyaluronic Cloud Hydra-Gel Eye Patche
avis.texte: Complimentary from Peter Thomas Roth Clinical Skincare. The Water Drench Hyaluronic Cloud Eye Patches feel very hydrating and moisturizing under my eyes. The texture is gel-like and is lightweight. So soothing.

Gifted by Peter Thomas Roth. These eye patches are so nice. They're super hydrating and leave my under eyes feeling super plump and prepped for makeup. They have helped stop my under eyes from creasing. Highly recommend.

Gifted by Peter Thomas Roth I really love these water drench cloud eyepatch's. I would highly recommend Tommie, family and friends. I love putting these patches on at the end of a really long day. It really helps to just bring some relief to my tired eyes.

I have been using Peter Thomas Roth for years and absolutely love these eye masks. I'll put these in my fridge and keep them nice and chilled and then anytime I need a great deep puffing or just a relaxation moment I pull these guys out gifted by Peter Thomas Roth.

This hyaluronic eye patch is the most hydrating one out of all the eye patches I've tried. It gives my under eyes and instant awake look. My eyes look so much better after using these. It really helps with crows feet and gives it a lifted feeling. Gifted by Peter Thomas Roth Clinical Skincare

WOW! This patches do feel like a cloud. I like that they are lightweight but do not slide down. They help to refresh, hydrate, moisturize my skin under eyes. My fine lines and wrinkles and even crow's feel appear less. I love to use them every morning! Gifted by Peter Thomas Roth

I was looking for something for a girls night in, and Water Drench Hyaluronic Cloud Eye Patches just seems to be perfect for people of all skin concerns. It feels so cooling and hydrating, and our undereyes all look so bright after. complimentary from peterthomasroth

I'm obsessed with any type of eye patch and these are no different! I love keeping these in the fridge for an added cooling effect. They keep my eye area feeling super hydrated and helps my makeup apply beautifully! Gifted by Peter Thomas Roth Clinical Skincare.

This eye patches are perfect for either starting the day or having a self care night routine! They feel amazing but also leave your eyes looking so hydrated. I struggle with sensitive eyes also and these did not irritate them. Gifted by Peter Thomas Roth.

I received this complimentary from Peter Thomas Roth. I struggle with undereye dryness and these patches were great to hydrated the eye area and decrease puffiness. My eyes looked more alive and wake after using!

I am so beyond obsessed with this product! I've seen these eye patches everywhere and have been dying to try them. They are seriously a game changer! Make my under eyes feel so hydrated and ready for makeup. Gifted by PTR

From all of their eye patches these ones are my favourite. You can actually see a difference right away. It helps with puffiness and tired liking eyes. Also they are very hydrating and my under eye are becomes alive right away . Gifted by Peter Thomas Roth Clinical Skincare

Water Drench Hyaluronic Cloud Eye Patches are the best to soak my underyes and restore moisture. Love how it makes my skin feel . It brings back life to my under eyes . I received this complimentary from Peter Thomas Roth

Complimentary from Peter Thomas Roth Clinical Skincare. The PTR Water Drench Hyaluronic Cloud Eye Patches is an absolute dream. I've seen an improvement in my skin since using this product. I truly can't wait to see the long term results. It works well with my acne proned skin and my skin drinks it up to the point where I am obsessed with it. I am satisfied.

Interesting product. I was looking for something similar. Every morning my eyes are swollen and this product is a good one . Using it in the morning before my makeup and i am impressed. Very soft and hydrating . Gifted By Peter Thomas Roth Clinical

avis.titre: Hydrated and plumper after just one use
avis.texte: I love eye patches. Hyaluronic acid is one of my favorite ingredients and these eye patches make my under eyes look hydrated and plumper immediately, after just one use. This brand always delivers high quality products with results that show! gifted by peterthomasroth

These are the most hydrating under eye gels that I have ever tried. They are like literal clouds! They are soft and contour perfectly to my under eye. They don't slide or slip around like other eye masks do. Once I peel them off I notice instant hydration without any tacky residue! I love them so much.

avis.titre: This is what Heaven would feel like...
avis.texte: I love this brand and I love these eye patches...You definitely get your moneys worth. They last forever and feel amazing on my skin. Nice and cool. One of my favorite things to do before bed!

I went back and forth to buy this and I finally pulled the trigger and bought them. I am simply amazed at how my eyes look after using these. they are a game changer for me, especially right before going out or the night! Can you make me a tester for you? Would love samples? Can you make more small travel sizes?

avis.titre: My eyes have NEVER looked better!
avis.texte: I put them on every other day or two days, and my dark circles and fine lines practically disappear. Miracle product, definitely purchasing from here again!

avis.titre: Best eye gels on the market
avis.texte: I've been using these PTR eye gel patches for a few years now. I've tried at least a dozen others on the market and these are by far the best, IMO. Even better than the PTR gold eye gels. There is enough product on these that sometimes I'm able to use these gel patches twice! They definitely smooth out fine under eye lines and while I don't usually have much in the way of puffiness, when I do, it calms that as well. They are definitely worth the cost.

Eyes are so important. They are the first thing people look at and usually remember first. But under those eyes matters too. This product WORKS! It works so well that if they sold it by the keg I would immerse my entire body in it! Can you tell I'm over 65 lol!

avis.titre: Good but doesn't have a lot of product on them.
avis.texte: I've used the a couple of times now and they're great but it doesn't feel like they have a lot of product on them. Although they feel lovely, it doesn't give much confidence as each patch is a bit scarce with "serum" or product. It feels like they dry out and there isn't any left over once removed from the eyes so it feels that there isn't much on them in the first place. I'll definitely use these up! But not entirely sure I'll repurchase.

I have tried the cucumber PTR, potent c power PTR eye patches and now the water drench. the water drench are my favorite out of the three for a few reasons. one: these patches have the most serum out of all 3! I store them in my fridge upside and they are soaked with serum. two: they actually work to reduce my fine lines under my eyes, which helps a lot with concealer application. I leave them on for 10-30 minutes depending on how much time I have. and I use them about 3-5 times a week! I will definitely repurchase these eye patches. I do NOT recommend the potent c power ones (no serum). and the cucumber ones had serum if i turned it upside. but I would still pick the water drench eye patches over the cucumber ones for the reasons above! I suggested buying from ulta instead of the black and white makeup store bc ulta has a MUCH better rewards program, and the other two PTR I got from the black and white makeup store I wasnt totally happy with the batches I bought bc not a ton of serum for the cost. ulta for the win!
I've been experiencing dryness like never before and these have truly helped. Soothing and smoothing of fine lines, that is definitely noticeable.
Love these patches! They are very cooling and soothing, and I do notice a difference in my under eyes when I use them -- they feel firmer and look smoother.

I use these several times a week. I'm 54, have dry skin, and have fine lines around my eyes. I leave these patches on until the serum has completely transferred to my skin. This typically takes about 15 minutes. These patches leave my under eye smooth, plump and hydrated. They take about 10 years off my face. If the top layers seem dry simply turn container over for 12 hours to redistribute serum. Remember to tighten lid before flipping container! FIT: I use these by placing smaller end on the inner corner of my eye, allowing the tip to lay on the side of the bridge of my nose. There will be a little bit of skin directly under the eye that isn't covered; I use my finger to pick up some of the serum by lightly swiping the patch and then swiping the small bit of exposed skin. I absolutely love these and continue to repurchase despite the cost.

I didn't fall in love with these until I did 2 things: 1. store them in the fridge... omg they feel amazingly cool and refreshing! 2. use them daily. I have been using these daily for about 2 weeks or so and you can see a major difference in the fine lines around my eyes. I wear them "pointy side down" to target my crow's feet. I keep them on for about 30 minutes each day. I have never found these to be dry. I've actually found mine to have so much serum that at times they slip down a bit and I have to readjust them back into place. They help replenish the moisture in my skin that had been depleted from retinol products.

This was recommended by an employee and I WILL NEVER listen to them ever again. This hurt the underneath of not only my eyes but my fiancés as well. The underneath of our eyes stung and once we took them off they were beat red. NEVER AGAIN!
I used after childbirth and before I had visitors and it really worked!
Love these gels, feel so good around my eyes with a cooling sensation. My eyes and skin look refreshed and bright.

avis.titre: Ok I'm back to change my review
avis.texte: Pros- hydrating, cooling, refreshing Cons- if they're dry when you first open then close lid tightly and store sideways or upside down to get the liquid redistributed. The shape is a little weird with this hook on the narrow end. I was going to return these. They were sooo dry I could barely even get them to stay on my eye. I even shook up the jar before using and it made somewhat of a difference but not enough to make me happy to spend 50+ dollars. I put them in my purse to return and complained to a friend about it and she wanted to see——I open it up and it's fully saturated. I guess it really just needed to be jostled around and sitting sideways to get the serum redistributed. I didn't return. I've used twice since and they're great. Shape isn't amazing but it's working fine. They're definitely cooling and hydrating.

avis.titre: Barely any product on patch, I was expecting hydration
avis.texte: These are hands down the driest eye patches I've ever used. Oddly enough they're also the most expensive. Sometimes when I go to put them on there's not even enough on the patch to get it to stick to my skin. I have to shake up the jar to try and get them coated sufficiently. I'm disappointed, I'll stick with the other patches I get for almost half the cost.
This product has helped not only hydrate my under eye to help with puffiness but it has also helped brighten my under eye, getting rid of my dark circles. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: After 3 days i can tell the difference
avis.texte: I took a before and after photo because i was skeptical about it. I mean if it were this easy wouldn't everyone do it? Truth is, no. So many people are skeptical and other can't afford it. I decided to splurge (I'm 37) and love the results thus far.
Love this product. They are my go-to for eye patches. Had to buy a second container for my daughter.

For the amount that you pay for these it's unacceptable that they dry up in a months time. I don't use these everyday. Maybe three times a week. Within a month they were all dry! I've had better luck with the Patchology eye patches.
They instantly depuff my under eyes, they hydrate and give my skin a glow! I place mine in the fridge for an amazing cooking effect. 10/10 recommended!
I have bought these for years. If you use them consistently you will definitely see results.

avis.titre: I would not recommend this product
avis.texte: I particularly have very sensitive and dry skin. Therefore, I'm very cautious of products I utilize for my face. After two attempts of using this product, my I experienced a burning sensation after placing on my skin. I immediately washed the substance off and realized it was an ingredient in the product that wasn't agreeing with my skin. In less than 24 hours my eyes began to swell. I returned both products but keep in mind I utilized these products nearly 12 months apart. There was no doubt an ingredient in this product caused an allergic reaction. I would recommend using it on other areas in small quantity.
I use this twice to three times a week, i do see more brightness under my eyes however i still feel like i have to apply some sort of eye cream under my eyes even after taking off the eye patches.

avis.titre: These save my eyes EVERY DAY!
avis.texte: I absolutely love these eye patches. I have an hour commute and I get up pretty early (so I'm normally pretty tired). I pop these on and leave them on for about 40 minutes and my eyes look great! I naturally have dark under eyes so having bags too looks twice as bad! I don't typically use these every single day but when I need them they really help!
This product is great to use morning or night and is so refreshing on my face!!

I am a firm believer that skincare should be time set aside to intentionally care for the mind body and soul. These patches really help me to feel refreshed and rejuvenated in the morning or after a long day at work on the Ulta Beauty sales floor. They do an amazing job at hydrating the under eye and I almost feel like they're helping to drain the lymphatic fluid out from my under eye as well, leaving them de-puffed and nourished.

avis.titre: Healed my itchy dermatitis on eyelid!
avis.texte: Allergies wrecked the skin around my eyes, the skin was dry, red and burning/itching. I found these patches and they relieved my skin right away...a miracle thank goodness. Also, they made my skin plump and glows, which was a bonus!

I am a swimmer and I needed something to get rid of the "goggle lines" that would remain under my eyes for the whole day after I swam. These work like a charm and my eyes look so great! Highly recommend and agree with another reviewer-I wear these as long as I can (if I have time) which is sometimes an hour or more. When they start to dry out I take them off.
I really like these. They're so much better than the cheap ones. They are large but that's ok. I've got dry under eyes and dry cheeks. They stay on just fine while I relax with them on.

avis.titre: This works well to depuff eyes and minimize wrinkles.
avis.texte: I must admit the first time I used it, I saw no changes. I applied it as directed and left it in for 20 mins. I was so disappointed it didn't work. I was going to take it back but I decided to give it 1 more time due to the positive reviews on YouTube. The next day I left it on for over an hour & that's when the magic happened. So if you suffer from severe bags and/or wrinkles & fine lines leave the patches on for an hour or more. My only con is I have to wear the patches longer than the recommended time to get instant results.

I usually purchase the 24k gold ones by PTR, but I decided to try these instead. I've used about 5 sets and I'm not sure if I notice anything as far as improvements. That said, I was in between jars and was tired of purchasing a set of drugstore eye gels for $4-6 a set whenever I wanted a pampering sesh. Do the math on that one. At least with this I can do my at home facials or even just throw on a pair in the morning while I drink my coffee and if you do the math, that's $2 a pair (roughly). The price is actually more affordable than drugstore brand, so I'll take it. I'm going to see if these make a difference with prolonged usage, and if not, I'm going to go back to the gold ones, which I do think you see a difference with after one use...oh and btw, I also will throw a pair of these on before bed to let them moisturize over night. Dont cause irritation or anything like that, at least for me.

PTR is the holy grail. I love all of the products I've tried so far, and these are no different. They tingle a little because of the HA, but they're SO hydrating. I love that they cover your entire eye area. I put them in my skincare fridge to keep them cold. Seriously, you can't go wrong with these or any of the eye patches.
